_source: QY Maple season schedule + EOG roadmap, EXPLICIT (pre-recurrence) schema: every event is a (season, day-in-season) entry; no recurring array. Treasure Hunt + mini-game folded in as explicit weekly entries mapped from EOG cumulative days (S1: qy=eog, S2: -46, S3: -113). S1 is confirmed (your first hunt Jul 3 = S1 day 8 matches EOG); S2+ treasure days are EOG estimates that can drift with your server's season lengths. Void Rifts/Chaos Invasion: S1 Sundays only, phase GUESSED (Void first) - verify and extend for S2+. S4/S5 treasure and tournaments not included.
